latin: locas sub ipsum funus et sepulcri
english: put out on contract right on the very funeral, and, of the tomb
problem: 'sub ipsum funus' rendered 'right on the very funeral', which puts the action at the funeral; sub here is 'close up to / on the eve of' (the note itself gives lit. 'under the very funeral'). Sense is close but the English line is not the literal rendering.
suggested: put out on contract close upon the very funeral, and, of the tomb
